create_BaseWrapper_subclass: create a subclass of BaseWrapper that implements _format_input_seq and format_output_seq for a new Diplomacy task
load_parlai_agent_cached: load a ParlAI agent from a model path with frozen override options using the LRU cache
freeze_dictionary_args: freeze a dictionary of override args into a frozenset for safe caching of ParlAI agent loads
set_generation_args: set beam size, topk, topp, temperature, and inference mode on a BaseWrapper instance for decoding
score_candidate_seqs: score a list of candidate output sequences against a game state using the wrapped ParlAI model
